status: User accepted the 2 exact diagnostic sites on 2026-10-07. Focused qualification and its recorded limits are unchanged. Full RPM and native architecture qualification remain separate gates.
root_cause: GCC retains paths for unnamed enum values. Every declared CallDescriptor::Kind assigns opcode; every declared MachineRepresentation either assigns the load opcode or takes an unconditional failure path.
source_review: InstructionSelectorT::VisitCall switches on the CallDescriptor Kind constructed by compiler linkage helpers. All eight declared kinds are handled, including the four WebAssembly kinds enabled in this package.

GetLoadOpcode handles all 21 distinct MachineRepresentation values. None, MapWord, IndirectPointer and Float16RawBits terminate. Compressed representations terminate without pointer compression. ProtectedPointer requires sandbox support. Every returning case initializes opcode.

The observed load warning is in VisitWord32AtomicLoad after inlining GetLoadOpcode. Its representation comes from the typed compiler load operation; its integral/tagged representation invariants further restrict the accepted inputs.

coverage.call: All eight declared kinds, both frame-state settings, general/floating argument counts 0/1/8/255, and three flag combinations. Correct opcode selection and branch-specific parameter/flag propagation.
coverage.load: All 21 declared representations, both signedness settings, pointer compression enabled/disabled, and every unsupported representation rejection.
coverage.memory: Both Valgrind runs report zero errors and free every allocation. No suppressions.
coverage.compiler: Each GCC13 build reproduces exactly the two opcode maybe-uninitialized warnings.

limits: Enum declarations, GetLoadOpcode and the call selection switch are verbatim extracts. Typed descriptor/load adapters expose the selected result.
Instruction opcode numeric values and field encodings are symbolic control adapters; this verifies dispatch and initialization, not instruction emission or execution.
CHECK/UNREACHABLE rejection becomes a typed test exception. This makes negative paths observable with complete cleanup; production termination behavior is unchanged.

Linux does not use the AIX function-descriptor branch, which is excluded. The package uses its existing uncompressed configuration; the additional compressed control checks the other source branch only.
An initial extraction script used an incorrect enum delimiter and stopped before generation; the corrected script and final outputs are retained.
No package compiler flags, runtime behavior or diagnostic filters change.
